voices.name: George
voices.line: George here. Pull up a blanket; the late show is only just getting warm.

voices.name: Lily
voices.line: This is Lily. If the night feels long, let it. I'll keep you company.

voices.name: Callum
voices.line: Callum speaking. If you hear knocking on the roof, it's the wind. Probably.

voices.name: Laura
voices.line: Laura here, and yes, I did eat the last biscuit. No regrets whatsoever!

voices.name: Brian
voices.line: Brian, on the late shift. Slow breaths. The world can wait until morning.

voices.name: Charlie
voices.line: Charlie here! Three in the morning and the energy is still sky high. Let's go!

voices.name: Alice
voices.line: Alice here. Fun fact: owls can't move their eyes, so they turn their whole heads.

voices.name: Daniel
voices.line: Daniel with the news. The moon rose on time tonight. No further updates.

voices.name: Harry
voices.line: Harry. I guard the snack cupboard. Nobody passes. Nobody.

voices.name: Jessica
voices.line: Jessica here! The request line is open, so call in and make my night.

voices.name: Bill
voices.line: Bill here. Sixty years of night shifts, and the stars still surprise me.

voices.name: Matilda
voices.line: Matilda here. Tonight's forecast: soft clouds, and a good chance of dreams.

voices.name: Francisca
voices.full: Francisca - Friendly and Calm Voice over
voices.line: Hola, soy Francisca. Aquí en Night Radio, la noche recién está comenzando.

voices.name: Alberto Rodríguez
voices.line: Les habla Alberto. Esta noche, una historia que nadie se ha atrevido a contar.

voices.name: Silvana
voices.line: Soy Silvana. Si no puedes dormir, quédate un rato con nosotros.

voices.name: July
voices.line: ¡Hola! Soy July, y esta noche estudiamos juntos con música suave.
